description: Output format presets shared by scripts/studio.py and the studio runtime. Safe areas are conservative workspace defaults (fractions of width/height), not platform-certified values; override per format in project.json when a platform publishes different guidance.
notes: text_floor_fraction mirrors the HyperFrames craft rule text_below_floor (2.6% of the frame's short side).
HyperFrames --resolution only supersamples by whole multiples at the same aspect ratio; other sizes need their own entry file (scripts/studio.py formats --size).
